ICED.text: cooled with ice, or covered with icing

MEAN.text: to intend to say or express something

VAPE.text: to breathe in vapour from an electronic cigarette

WERE.text: past tense of be, used with you, we and they

WHEN.text: at what time; at the time that

WOKE.text: past tense of wake: stopped sleeping

WORE.text: past tense of wear: had clothes on
